note: Reach floors and downgrade floors for scripts/action-pin-comment-gate.mjs. minPins and minFilesWithUses are FLOORS, not equalities: adding a step is ordinary, losing one silently is the failure this records. The floor map is a MINIMUM VERSION per action, and it is also an ALLOW-LIST, because it is keyed by full owner/repo and an action with no entry fails as NO-FLOOR. That is what catches a fork or a typosquat, which the version checks cannot, because they would grade a fork honestly against the fork. Lower a floor only in the same commit as the pin, with the reason in the commit message.
